findings.statement: 13 quest roots are documented; phase 13 defines 19 quests/five tracks with objectives, NPCs, locations, prerequisites and beats. Many remain in progress.
Two active PKD quest entries diverge (31 vs 10 quests); engine de-dup makes order 43 effective. Events call 26 IDs; five are uncalled. IDs horaDeCrescer, 2 and resgatarCorvos, 2/3 are malformed.
Runtime uses V26-35/40-41 for main progress, V62-66 for scores and V67-83 for stages; docs suggest V1-5. V84/V85 conflict with Map036 smith flags; V96/V97 are unnamed.

Docs allocate 500 preparation points; events/plugins own rewards because SQSM callbacks are zero. Map036 duplicates owners from maps 7/8/9/11/17/47/52; V62 writers conflict with documented +50/+25/+25. No reachability claim.

Dependencies, items, locations and page gates encode preconditions; score/stage writes, SQSM completion and transfers encode postconditions. Failure and auto-complete are off; retry/fail coverage is sparse; Playtest pending.

publication_intent: Publish static quest facts, drift, risks and gates under the quest-content-designer domain; no rewrite or reachability claim.
